title.zh: 儿童DIY插珠帐篷拼搭套装

summary.zh:
这是一款面向儿童创意拼搭场景的DIY插珠帐篷玩具，采用PP与ABS组合材质，通过杆件与连接球快速搭建城堡、帐篷和通道等结构，适用于家庭亲子互动、课堂活动与游戏区布置。

产品支持重复拆装与形态重构，品牌为尧顺，产地中国，定位跨境出口供货，可用于零售上架与项目型采购。
summary.en:
This is a DIY bead-and-rod fort toy for children’s creative construction play. It uses a PP and ABS material combination and allows quick building of castles, tents, and tunnel-like structures for family interaction, classroom activities, and play-area setups.

The set is designed for repeated assembly and reconfiguration. Brand: Yaoshun. Origin: China. It is positioned for cross-border export supply and suitable for both retail listing and project-based procurement.

zh: 该款儿童DIY插珠帐篷拼搭套装以“杆件+连接球”结构为核心，孩子可根据空间大小和主题需求自由拼接城堡、帐篷、通道等造型。PP/ABS材质兼顾轻量化与结构稳定性，支持反复拆装与多次重构。
产品适用于亲子互动、幼教活动、课程道具和节庆游戏区搭建等场景。通过组合搭建过程，可用于动手训练、空间认知与团队协作类活动，兼顾玩法趣味与展示效果。
该商品支持跨境渠道供货，提供多种杆球组合方案与彩盒包装，便于不同市场和客户做SKU配置。配套导购视频与品牌授权信息，适合电商上架及长期项目采购。
en: This kids DIY fort building set is based on a rod-and-connector-ball structure. Children can freely build castles, tents, and tunnel-style shapes according to available space and play themes. The PP/ABS material combination balances lightweight handling and structural stability, and supports repeated assembly and reconfiguration.

It is suitable for parent-child interaction, preschool activities, educational props, and event play-area setup. The construction process can be used for hands-on training, spatial awareness, and team collaboration activities while maintaining strong play value and display appeal.

The product is available for cross-border channel supply with multiple rod-and-ball configuration options and color-box packaging, making SKU planning easier for different markets. Guide videos and own-brand authorization details are provided for e-commerce listing and long-term project procurement.

value.zh: 可多次变换形状，支持重复拆装
value.en: Reconfigurable shapes with repeated assembly support

value.zh: 非洲、欧洲、南美、东南亚、北美、东北亚、中东
value.en: Africa, Europe, South America, Southeast Asia, North America, Northeast Asia, Middle East

key.zh: 是否跨境出口专供货源

value.zh: 提供12种杆球组合（如44杆+25球、54杆+31球、80杆+40球等），含常规与夜光版本。
value.en: 12 rod-and-ball combinations are available (such as 44 rods + 25 balls, 54 rods + 31 balls, and 80 rods + 40 balls), including regular and glow variants.
